title: Career Roadmap: Dealer/Trader (Junior)
summary: Career Domain: Business, Finance & Entrepreneurship · Qualification Pathway: B.Com – B.Com - Financial Markets · Target Career: Dealer/Trader (Junior)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

about.label: Important
about.text: Never trade with borrowed money while learning; SEBI data show most individual derivatives traders lose money.

blocks.text: A Junior Dealer executes buy and sell orders in shares, derivatives, currencies or commodities for a broking firm's clients or its own book, quickly and within strict risk limits.

items.text: Place and track orders on the trading terminal
Follow client instructions and the firm's risk limits
Watch markets and news that move prices
Reconcile trades and report positions at day end
Learn how stock exchanges, orders and settlement work
Paper-trade and keep a trading journal
Clear the NISM certifications for dealers
Learn technical and fundamental analysis basics
Intern at a broking firm or dealing desk
Learn risk management and SEBI rules for brokers
Apply for dealer and back-office trading roles
Exchange trading terminals (NSE NOW, ODIN and similar)
NISM Series VII - Securities Operations and Risk Management
NISM Series I / XVI for currency / commodity derivatives

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
